business_problem: Mojo Fertility had built AI-based sperm-testing technology, but traditional lab testing was still slow, inaccessible and inaccurate for many consumers, and the company needed a way to make testing easier to adopt and easier to deliver safely outside the clinic.
solution_summary: Mojo Fertility worked with EY teams to extend its AI-based sperm analysis technology into a direct-to-consumer service. Mojo's core technology counts sperm with high accuracy and computes sperm count, motility and DNA integrity, but the broader challenge was operationalizing that capability for consumers and clinics. EY researched target audiences, repositioned the value proposition around men's health data, and designed the Mojo Home Kit so users could collect samples at home and send them to the lab quickly. The solution combined the AI testing capability with a digitally coordinated pickup experience, packaging built to keep samples viable and a service flow that made the lab process simpler for end users. By pairing AI-based analysis with product design, logistics and a targeted launch campaign, Mojo turned a specialized diagnostic workflow into a more scalable customer experience.

solution_components.name: AI-based technology
solution_components.role: Analyzes sperm samples to compute count, motility and DNA integrity with greater accuracy than manual lab counting.

solution_components.name: Mojo Home Kit
solution_components.role: Lets users collect samples at home and connect them to the lab testing workflow.

solution_components.name: digital platform
solution_components.role: Coordinates seamless and immediate sample pickup so the home-collection workflow can operate reliably.

solution_components.name: collection flask
solution_components.role: Keeps samples viable long enough for medically secure transport from the home to the lab.

data_flow: Users collect a sample with the Mojo Home Kit and collection flask, then the digital platform triggers rapid pickup and transport to the lab. Once received, Mojo's AI-based testing computes sperm count, motility and DNA integrity so results can be returned through the service flow without the manual counting bottleneck of traditional testing.
business_outcome: Mojo made fertility testing more accessible, more marketable and easier to scale by combining AI-based analysis with a home-testing experience, faster logistics and a stronger route to consumers and clinics.
